title: The Lay of the Land in Idiom-Translation Quality Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2610.35261v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Idioms have long been a challenge for machine translation, and while large language models (LLMs) have proven increasingly adept at handling them, whether quality estimation (QE) systems have kept pace and can reliably score idiomatic renderings of these expressions above faulty literal ones remains unclear. We introduce the first parallel dataset pairing idiom-bearing English sentences with both literal and idiomatic translations across nine target languages, augmented into multi-sentence segments and a graded literality continuum. Using this dataset, we benchmark eleven conventional QE metrics from the COMET and MetricX families and ten LLMs from the Qwen-3, Gemma-4 and OLMo-3 families used as GEMBA-style judges. We find that most systems, especially older metrics and smaller models, display a marked literality bias, rating literal translations of idioms above idiomatic ones. translated_title: 习语翻译质量评估的现状
translated_abstract: 习语长期以来一直是机器翻译面临的挑战。尽管大型语言模型（LLM）在处理习语方面已被证明越来越得心应手，但质量评估（QE）系统是否跟上了这一步伐、能否可靠地将习语的地道翻译评得高于错误的直译，仍不清楚。我们推出了首个平行数据集，将包含习语的英语句子与九种目标语言下的直译和地道翻译配对，并扩展为多句段落以及一个分级直译程度连续体。利用该数据集，我们对来自COMET和MetricX系列的十一种传统QE指标，以及来自Qwen-3、Gemma-4和OLMo-3系列的十个用作GEMBA式评判者的LLM进行了基准测试。我们发现，大多数系统，尤其是较旧的指标和较小的模型，表现出明显的直译偏好，将习语的直译评分高于地道翻译。更高的参数量和更新的训练集似乎能够缓解这种偏差。
tldr: 该研究构建了首个用于习语翻译质量评估的平行数据集，涵盖九种目标语言的直译与地道译文，并揭示现有QE指标和LLM普遍存在直译偏好，倾向于将习语的直译评为优于地道翻译。
en_tdlr: This study introduces the first parallel dataset for idiom-translation quality estimation across nine target languages and reveals that most QE metrics and LLMs exhibit a marked literality bias, rating literal translations of idioms above idiomatic ones.
